static_traits.name: Chen Taile
static_traits.social_status: not very social, lacking a support system
static_traits.medical_history: never experienced similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, highly cooperative, able to describe emotions and events concretely; with self-criticism and Self-denial tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: I am troubled by poor eating habits and lack of social interaction; despite a recent promotion at Work, I still feel like an 'antisocial loser'. These feelings persisted for a while but intensified after the promotion, leading to self-critical thoughts, further self-isolation and doubting my achievements, attributing them to negative traits rather than effort.
basic_info.core_demands: Due to negative self-cognition after promotion, seeks help to cope with and improve these problems.

core_beliefs: I do not deserve success, nor deserve recognition

special_situations.event: Facing higher responsibilities and expectations after promotion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot perform perfectly or immediately meet all Demands, it proves I do not deserve, I am a loser
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: working harder but negating own achievements, attributing the promotion to luck or having no one else available
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not deserve the promotion, it is just good luck or no one else available

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: speaking in public must be flawless, otherwise I will be laughed at, meaning I am not suited to lead
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to speak as little as possible in meetings, repeatedly replays and criticizes herself afterwards, and later avoids speaking in public settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone must think I am ridiculous

special_situations.event: encountering a client dissatisfied with the service
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if the client is unhappy, it must be that I did badly and will be complained about
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Apologizes excessively, eager to make amends to immediately eliminate negative feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will complain about me; I messed things up

special_situations.event: Reflecting on one's social situation and self-isolating
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I am not socially skilled or not sociable, that equals being a loser
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: further Reduced socializing, keeping distance from people to avoid judgment

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to be seen as a competent and trustworthy person
core_conflict.fear: fear of being negated and laughed at, worrying about exposing 'inadequacies' and failing
defense_goal: Keeps a low profile and avoids to reduce chances of being evaluated
Gains a sense of security and recognition through excessive effort

object_relations.self_representation: an undeserving 'impostor', someone who may fail at any moment
object_relations.object_representation: picky judges, others who will laugh at and negate me

manifestations: not very social, lacking a support system
outcomes: Worsening eating habits, declining body-mind state

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing colleagues 'all treat me as a joke'
directly attributing client dissatisfaction to one's incompetence, believing the other will complain about oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Avoids speaking in meetings, holds back expression
Turns outward expression and energy into inner self-harshness and rumination

positive_force: Engaged in work and competent (efforts earned the promotion)
Has motivation to change and actively seeks help
Able to notice and concretely describe negative automatic thoughts
negative_force: Self-denial, negating positive evidence (negating the positive meaning of the promotion)
tendency to predict the future and catastrophize, highly sensitive to negative evaluation
Excessively seeking external evaluation and approval
poor eating habits affecting mental-physical state and daily functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids speaking and taking on 'in the spotlight' tasks in work settings
antecedent: Needing to host or lead meetings after promotion
When thinking about being evaluated by colleagues or superiors
When facing high expectations and new duties
target_behavior.core_reason: strong impostor feelings and low self-worth, fear of being laughed at and negated
target_behavior.function: escaping judgment and potential failure, temporarily easing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Productivity declines, hesitation and mistakes increase, forming a vicious cycle

antecedent: when Reflecting on one's social situation or lack of interaction
target_behavior.core_reason: labeling oneself an 'antisocial loser' causing shame and Self-denial
target_behavior.function: avoiding embarrassment and Being rejected, reducing judgment risk
target_behavior.consequence: Weak support system, worsening loneliness, further deteriorating mood and functioning

target_behavior.behavior: over-apologizing, nervousness and rushing to make amends when facing client dissatisfaction
antecedent: when clients express dissatisfaction or complain
target_behavior.core_reason: personalized and future-predicting cognitions, believing complaints are inevitable and performance poor
target_behavior.function: Tries to quickly eliminate threats and gain external recognition
target_behavior.consequence: appearing less confident, increasing Self-doubt and tension, affecting subsequent performance

target_behavior.behavior: unhealthy eating (often eating junk food after coming home)
antecedent: Exhausted after work, lacking energy to cook
target_behavior.core_reason: insufficient energy and Low mood, lack of planning, using food for short-term mood regulation
target_behavior.function: Gaining short-term comfort and saving time
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental state declines, affecting daily life and work performance
